faqs.question: Should I use ⛺🔥 in a wedding hashtag?
faqs.answer: Skip ⛺🔥 in a wedding hashtag — the travel register is the wrong tone for wedding-coded moments.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ⛺🔥 and ⛺🔥 in a softer register?
faqs.answer: ⛺🔥 is the travel-coded "name" — the cue is the journey. ⛺🔥 in a softer register reads as a different register; check the partner emoji to read the precise shade.

faqs.question: Is ⛺🔥 a flex?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Travel-coded combos can read performative when paired with a luxury-coded partner emoji. Watch the lead-up.
